FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No: RC-CFS/439/2024/RC E-1450227
Dated 11.07.2024 regarding altering the limits of Chowdapura village of KUDLIGI
Taluk VIJAYANAGARA District and constituting a new revenue village called
Aigalamallapura, T.Basapura and a new revenue sub village called Chowdapura
Gollarahatti was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette Dated:03.08.2024
inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby
within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner VIJAYANAGARA district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 06.08.2024. And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
Chowdapura village of KUDLIGI Taluk VIJAYANAGARA District to form a new
revenue village called as Aigalamallapura village of KUDLIGI Taluk
(18151)

of KUDLIGI taluk of VIJAYANAGARA District convert the same to form

in after be named as Chowdapura Gollarahatti of Chowdapura village in
KUDLIGI Taluka of VIJAYANAGARA District.

village Kyatankeri of Indi taluk in Vijayapur District to form a new revenue village
called as Nananayak Nagar of Indi taluk Vijayapur District along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the, Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of D.Hosahalli Village of
Kadur taluk Chikmagaluru District and to constitute a new revenue villages
called Ranganathapura as specified in schedule.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of
D.Hosahalli village for conversion of Ranganathapura unrecorded habitation in to
hamlet/part of the said revenue village.
Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date Specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objection or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner, Chikmagaluru District.

SCHEDULE
Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column(3) of the
table shall be declared as habitation area of called Ranganathapura village of
Kadur Taluk of Chikmagaluru District convert the same to form hamlet within the
boundary of D.Hosahalli Revenue village and same will herein after be named as
called Ranganathapura of D.Hosahalli village in Kadur Taluk of Chikmagaluru
District.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No:RC-CFS/51/2024-RC E-1312049 Dated:
25-03-2024 regarding altering the limits of Kalagatta village of Holalkere Taluk and
Chitradurga District and constituting a new revenue village called Priya nagara and
Sri immadi siddrameshwara nagara and new revenue sub village called Hosa
badavane from new revenue village Sri immadi siddrameshwara nagara was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette Dated: 24-06 -2024 inviting
objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within
thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the
Deputy Commissioner Chitradurga district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 24-06 -2024 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

Kalagatta village of Holalkere Taluk and Chitradurga District to form a new
revenue village called as Priya nagara village of Holalkere Taluk and Chitradurga
District along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

Whereas the draft of the Notification No:RC-CFS/5/2023-RC Dated:
13-03-2024 regarding altering the limits of Malagondanahalli village of Davanagere
Taluk and Davanagere District and constituting a new revenue village called
Badiyanaikanahalli was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette
Dated:18-06-2024 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Davanagere district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:18-06-2024; And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village Malagondanahalli of Davanagere Taluk and Davanagere District to form a
new revenue village called as Badiyanaikanahalli of Davanagere Taluk in
Davanagere District along with the survey numbers included in column (4)
thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 49 GLH 2023, Dated:
20-02-2023regarding altering the limits of Kalavara village of Chikkaballapura
Taluk in Chikkaballapura District and constituting a new revenue sub village called
as Upagrama Kalavara sub village was published as required by section 6 of the
Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka
Gazette Dated: 06-03-2023 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons
likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the
Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Chikkaballapura district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:07-03-2023; And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE

Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column(3) of the
table shall be declared as habitation area of Upagrama Kalavara village of
Chikkaballapura Taluk in Chikkaballapura District convert the same to form
hamlet within the boundary of Kalavara revenue village and same will here in after be
named as called Upagrama Kalavara of Kalavara village in Chikkaballapura
Taluk of Chikkaballapura District.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No: RC-CFS0ADMN/353/2024/RC
E-1350203 Dated 07.03.2024 regarding altering the limits of Kadabageri village of
HARAPANAHALLI Taluk VIJAYANAGARA District and constituting a new
revenue village called Kasavanahalli was published as required by section 6 of the
Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka
Gazette dated:02.07.2024 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons
likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the
Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner VIJAYANAGARA district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:12.07.2024 And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
Kadabageri village of HARAPANAHALLI Taluk VIJAYANAGARA District to
form a new revenue village called as Kasavanahalli of HARAPANAHALLI Taluk
VIJAYANAGARA District along with the survey numbers included in column (4)
thereof.

NOTIFICATION
In para 6 at Sl. No.1 of the Notification No. FEE 3 FWL 2016, dated 24.06.2016 and
subsequent amendment dated 12.09.2017, the following shall be substituted:

‘’ 1) (a) No person including shopkeeper, vendor, wholesaler, retailer, trader,
hawker or salesperson shall manufacture, procure, stock, sell and use
Chinese Manja or Chinese Dor which is made of Nylon thread or other
Synttretic (Non Bio-Degadable) threads coated with glass or other harmful
substances used for kite flying in the State.

(b) Kite flying shall be permissible only with a cotton thread that is free from
any sharp, metallic or glass components, adhesives, or any other thread-
strengthening materials.’’

No. FEE 97 FAF 2024 Karnataka Government Secretariat,
M. S. Building,
Bengaluru, dated:16.10.2024

NOTIFICATION
Whereas, after the convention on Biological Diversity negotiation, the Government of
India has passed Biological Diversity Act 2002, for the purpose of conservation of
biodiversity, sustainable use of components of biodiversity, fair and equitable sharing of
benefits arising out of the utilization of genetic resources. Section 37 of the Act provides for
declaration of certain areas as Biodiversity Heritage Sites by the State Government. As per
the guidelines issued by the Central Government, the areas having unique ecological fragile
ecosystem, species richness, high endemism, presence of rare, endemic and threatened

species. Keystone Species, species of evolutionary significance, wild ancestors of
domestic/cultivated species or land races or other varieties, past pre-eminence of biological
components represented by fossil bodies and having cultural or aesthetic values may be
declared as heritage sites.

Whereas, Notified Forests of Mamadapur village located in Vijayapur District are a
vital ecological region characterized by dry deciduous and scrub forests. It serves as a
habitat for various species of flora and fauna, including Leopards, Indian foxes, hyenas and
numerous bird species. The forest also plays a crucial role in water conservation, soil
stabilization and supporting the livelihoods of local communities. The surrounding
waterbodies add natural beauty and aesthetic value to the site.

Whereas proposals were received from the Chief Conservator of Forests , Belagavi
Circle, Belagavi and Deputy Conservator of Forests, Vijayapura Regional Division,
Vijayapura requesting to re-nomenclature the previously declared various adjacent Notified
Forest Areas of Mamadapura village of Vijayapura District as heritage site based on the
following criteria:

 Unique Ecological Features: ‘The area is home to diverse species and unique habitats
that are important for maintaining regional biodiversity.

 Fragile Ecosystem: The forest supports a fragile ecosystem that is vulnerable to
human activities, requiring protection and sustainable management.

 Cultural Significance: Naming the site after Shri. Siddeshwar Swamiji recognizes his
contributions to environmental stewardship and aligns with his values of
conservation and community well-being.

 Community Support: There is-strong local Support for the declaration from local
environmental groups, community leaders.

Whereas, Shri. Siddeshwar Swamiji is deeply revered not only for his spiritual
teachings but also for his profound commitment towards protecting the environment and
uplifting the community. He believed that the health of the environment is directly linked
to the well-being of people, advocating harmonious relationship between humans and
nature, by declaring the notified forests of Mamadapur village as Shri. Siddeshwar Swamiji
Biodiversity Heritage Site, the Government of Kamataka would honor his legacy and
ensure that his principles guide the conservation and sustainable management of this
important ecological area.

Now therefore, in view of the circumstances explained above and as recommended
by the Principal Chief Conservator of Forest (HoFF), Bengaluru, the Mamadapura village of
Vijayapura District is declared as Shri Siddeshwara Swamiji Biodiversity Heritage Site as
per power vested in the State Government under Section 37 of Biological Diversity Act 2002.
The location details of the heritage site are as follows :

1 Name of the site - Shri Siddeshwara Swamiji Biodiversity Heritage
Site
2 Name of the district - Vijayapura

3 Taluk - Vijayapura
4 Gram Panchayat - Mamadapura
5 Extent - 1494 acres 38 Guntas
6 Mamadapura Survey - Mamadapur: Old- 345 P, 390 P, 347, 398. 401.
numbers New-345/1A, 390 A, 347, 398, 401

The declaration is subject to the following conditions.

1. The Heritage Site shall be managed as per duly approved Management Plan.
2. The right and privileges of local people shall continue to exist.
3. There should be full participation of local people in the management of Heritage Site.
4. No activities which are against the conservation of Biodiversity shall be allowed.

By Order & in the Name of the
Governor of Karnataka,

(SHANTHALAXMI.U)
Under Secretary to Government (I/c),
Forest, Ecology and Environment Dept
(Ecology and Environment)

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification NoRC-CFS0ADMN/15/2024-RC
E-1282484 Dated:21-02-2024 regarding altering the limits of K Yadathore village of
Heggadadevanakote Taluk and Mysuru District and constituting a new revenue
village called Udbooru Colony was published as required by section 6 of the
Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka
Gazette Dated:11-03-2024inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons
likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the
Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Mysuru district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:11-03-2024;And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village K Yadathore of Heggadadevanakote Taluk and Mysuru District to form a
new revenue village called as Udbooru Colony of Heggadadevanakote Taluk in
Mysuru District along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification NO RC-CFS/117/2024-RC E-1356309
Dated:14-03-2024regarding altering the limits of T.B. Kavalu village of Kadur
Taluk and Chikkamagaluru District and constituting a new revenue sub village called
as Dasara Colony sub village was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette
Dated:10-06-2024 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner Chikkamagaluru district.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on Dated:10-
06-2024.And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE

Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column(3) of the
table shall be declared as habitation area of Dasara Colonyvillage of Kadur Taluk in
Chikkamagaluru District convert the same to form hamlet/part within the boundary
of T.B.Kavalu revenue village and same will here in after be named as called Dasara
Colonyof T.B.Kavalu village in Kadur Taluk of Chikkamagaluru District.

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having

regard to the administrative convenience the, Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Kuppinakeri Village of
Kudligi taluk Vijayanagara District and to constitute a new revenue villages
called Kengalahatti as specified in schedule.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of
Kuppinakeri village for conversion of Kengalahatti unrecorded habitation in to
hamlet/part of the said revenue village.
Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date Specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objection or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner, Vijayanagara District.

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land

the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Madapura Village of
Heggadadevanakote Taluk, Mysuru District and to constitute a new revenue
villages called Devaraja Colony as specified in schedule along with maps with
old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, MysuruDistrict.
